verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a conventional web index with keyword-style operators (quotes, minus, site:), Goggles re-ranking, date and country filters, spell check, and an LLM Context endpoint with relevance thresholds. None of these documents meaning-based, embedding, or neural semantic retrieval that surfaces results keyword engines miss. Goggles re-ranking, 'query intent' rich verticals and relevance-threshold modes are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.
